bbox_note: bbox_pct values are approximate (estimated by eye) and are only meant for matching regions; x, y = top-left, w, h = size, in percent of the page.
excluded: Printed page number '3' (bottom right) and the car's licence plate (unreadable, under 12 px).
page_notes: Crime story, upright mechanical-looking upper-case lettering with some bold italic emphasis. Captions are tinted boxes (green, pink, cream).

regions.text: YOU! GET THAT VAULT OPEN!
I--I CAN'T! IT WORKS ON A TIME LOCK! IT WON'T OPEN TILL NINE-THIRTY!
regions.notes: 'NINE-' ends a line and 'THIRTY!' starts the next; the hyphen belongs to the compound and is kept.

regions.text: WE'LL WAIT! WATCH THE DOORS, MIKE. IT'S ONLY TEN MINUTES!
MANAGER
regions.notes: Desk nameplate, letters about 15 px tall; included because it is above the 12 px threshold.

regions.text: FINALLY, THE LOCK OPENED..
regions.notes: Dark text on a pale green caption box. Two dots, as drawn.

regions.text: JUST HAND OUT GREENBACKS! WE DON'T WANT SILVER!
I'LL GET IT! I'LL GET IT!
AS THE MANAGER FILLED THE BAG ONE OF THE CUSTOMERS COULD STAND IT NO LONGER...
regions.notes: Dark text on a pink caption box. 'COULD STAND' is drawn almost joined ('COULDSTAND'); written as two words.

regions.text: LET ME OUT! EEEE! LET ME OUT!
SHUT UP! I'M WARNING YOU!...
I OUGHT TO KILL YOU!
AHHHH!
MARA! WHAT HAPPENED?
TAKE IT EASY! IT WAS JUST A DAME THAT WENT OFF HER ROCKER.
AFTER THAT JOB THE TWO HID OUT NEAR TOPEKA. THE POLICE OF FIVE STATES AND THE F.B.I. WERE ON THEIR TRAIL! IN THE NEXT CABIN...
WHERE DID I SEE THEM BEFORE? PAPERS? THAT'S WHERE IT WAS! I BETTER PHONE THE POLICE!
regions.notes: 'PAPERS ?' is drawn with a space before the question mark. 'THAT'S WHERE IT WAS!' is bold italic.

regions.text: CABINS
regions.notes: Hand-painted sign with an arrow, drawn at an angle.

regions.text: OFFICE
regions.notes: Small sign with an arrow; letters about 20 px; first letter partly hidden by the sign edge.

regions.text: MOMENTS LATER...
...I'M SURE! THEY FIT THE DESCRIPTIONS PERFECTLY! THEY'RE THE BANK-ROBBERS, ALL RIGHT. YOU'RE SENDIN' MEN OUT? GOOD, I'LL BE WAITIN'!
regions.notes: 'BANK-ROBBERS' is hyphenated mid-line (not a line break). 'WAITIN' !' is drawn with a gap before the '!'.
